factual_rules_profile.scope: selected same-run V3 draft and final_primary
factual_rules_profile.mask: pair union; exclude only two established zero denominators
factual_rules_profile.delta: after minus before; exact fractions; unavailable remains null
factual_rules_profile.correspondence: validated adopted sources before unique fallback and review
factual_rules_profile.quality: independent checks; deletion and replacement do not repair old facts

method: Native density scoring and exact aggregation only; factual verdicts, masks, visit changes, correspondence and continuity preserved from the accepted same-run pair.

source_refs.quote: I am travelling alone on a limited budget. I would prefer to spend most of my sightseeing time in parks, exploring neighbourhoods and viewing architecture from outside, with a small number of paid visits. I am happy to prioritise lower-cost experiences.

review.rationale: Independently reviewed every original request field. Budget sensitivity, outdoor/exterior sightseeing and a small number of paid visits specify spending/activity mix, not a relaxed or rich total sightseeing pace. No exact daily total or date-specific pace/count is requested. Adopt ordinary with no exact count and no dated exceptions; do not treat paid visits as all primary visits.
